name: Grasshopper Farms | Grasshopper Glue
description: Vibrant hues of amber blanket the dark trichome-waxed buds of this tranquil sun-grown Indica. Savor its robust aroma, accented by notes of citrus and leather, which transitions into a velvety plush smoke gentle on the lungs. The mellow and serene effect of this strain offers a perfect opportunity to decompress mentally and physically without overwhelming sensations. The chill, soothing high associated with this strain serves as a passport to calmness, clarity, and relief.
